Definition: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jerusalem is the capital city of the land, the city David took and Solomon built the temple in. In Joshua 10:1, Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerusalem matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
